purpose: Document browser API assumptions and Electron-owned shell behavior for the Headless Remote Web app.

browser_api_assumptions.websocket: Remote Web connects to the local FastAPI websocket endpoint through Chromium without preload mediation.
browser_api_assumptions.local_storage: Chromium profile storage is retained by Electron; server state remains authoritative for shared runtime state.
browser_api_assumptions.session_storage: Chromium per-window session storage is acceptable for transient UI drafts only.
browser_api_assumptions.file_picker: HTML file inputs remain the default user file picker path.
browser_api_assumptions.clipboard: Standard Chromium clipboard and paste behavior is the default path; privileged shell clipboard APIs are not exposed to Remote Web yet.
browser_api_assumptions.drag_drop: Chromium drag/drop is the default path; dropped files must still be uploaded through existing Remote Web handlers.
browser_api_assumptions.downloads: Electron redirects browser downloads into the runtime downloads folder.
browser_api_assumptions.popups: HTTP and HTTPS window.open popups are opened as Electron child windows instead of external OS browser tabs.
browser_api_assumptions.browser_fallback: Remote Web can request the system browser through naia-open-browser://open?url=..., and Electron intercepts that scheme instead of navigating the app window.
browser_api_assumptions.portable_user_data: When a packaged app folder contains user-data next to the executable, Electron treats that directory as NAIA_USER_DATA_DIR without requiring a launcher script.
browser_api_assumptions.cdp_smoke: When NAIA_ELECTRON_REMOTE_DEBUGGING_PORT is set, Electron opens a Chromium remote-debugging endpoint for release smoke automation.

maintenance_view.purpose: Give users a visible shell-owned recovery surface before the Remote Web UI is available.
required_log_flow: backend stdout and stderr are captured by Electron
shell state exposes recent backend logs
maintenance view renders the shell log buffer
Open logs opens the runtime logs folder

layout_rules: log output is capped to visible lines
long package/status text wraps or ellipsizes
maintenance view must not use overflow:auto scroll panels
progress_contract.notes: Long runtime setup and data download phases must be visible before Remote Web loads, without horizontal or vertical scrollbars in the shell-owned maintenance window.

shell_affordances.notes: Shell-owned affordances must stay available in packaged mode: branded icon, hidden menu, explicit browser fallback, logs folder access, and data folder access.

hard_rules: The Electron main process must not import PyQt6 or legacy_desktop.
The backend must receive NAIA_USER_DATA_DIR from the Electron shell.
Browser downloads must not write into the bundled backend resource directory.
External HTTP popups should stay inside Electron-owned windows unless explicitly routed to the browser fallback.
The browser fallback scheme must only open HTTP/HTTPS URLs.
Portable app folders must work without a wrapper script that sets NAIA_PORTABLE.
CDP remote debugging must be opt-in through NAIA_ELECTRON_REMOTE_DEBUGGING_PORT.
